##### Project general facts

Casa Blanca is a villa resort by Land Scout Asia, conceived as a fully managed resort where each villa is individually owned. The community brings together one-storey one-bedroom villas and two-storey two-bedroom villas set along a lagoon crossed by footbridges. The architecture draws on Moorish and Mediterranean influences: sand-toned and terracotta volumes, arches, timber screens and patterned breeze-block walls create shade, privacy and a calm, distinctive character.

Owners and guests enjoy a resort setting with a reception and hospitality team, communal swimming pools lined with sun loungers, and shared amenities across the grounds. The two-bedroom villas add a generous upper-level terrace. The resort team handles guest stays and day-to-day operations, so owners can enjoy their own holidays, earn rental income between visits and retain the option to resell.

Materials and finishes are selected for durability in everyday hospitality use and long-term upkeep, with construction and planning decisions shaped by comfort, maintenance and daily operation. Every villa is delivered fully furnished and ready for guests.

##### Location description and benefits

Chaweng Noi is a quiet, green coastal neighbourhood on the east coast of Koh Samui, set between the island's two most popular beach destinations, Chaweng and Lamai. Chaweng Noi Beach is part of the neighbourhood, and the hillside behind it is surrounded by palm groves, boutique resorts, private villas and wellness retreats.

Samui International Airport, Chaweng with its restaurants and beach clubs, Silver Beach and Lamai are all a short drive away. PBISS International School, other international schools and Bangkok Hospital Samui are within easy reach, which makes the area convenient for families staying beyond a holiday, while Royal Samui Golf and padel courts add an active island lifestyle.

Koh Samui is one of Thailand's premier tourist destinations, served by its own international airport and welcoming visitors all year round, which supports a strong short-term rental market. Chaweng Noi appeals to holidaymakers, digital nomads and long-stay guests who want calm surroundings close to the island's main attractions, allowing owners to command premium nightly rates. Property in the area is held on a leasehold basis, with land registered under the applicable lease arrangement.
